name: Mahanagar Gas Ltd
title: Mahanagar Gas Ltd - 539957 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: City gas distributor under LNG supply curtailment: I&C supply cut to ~80%, March volumes lost ~20-22% in industrial, but FY26 volume grew 8.25% and management targets 10%+ FY27 growth with ~INR1,200 crore capex.

utilisation.quote: Overall, in the month of March, we lost about 1.25 lakh, 1.3 lakh scmd out of, let's say, Feb average of 5.75. About 20%, 22% volume we lost.

capex.quote: Certainly, it will be whatever we have been giving, INR1,200 crores range. It can be a little more than that if we are able to do and see

triggers.label: CNG pass-through incomplete
triggers.quote: It's certainly not fully passed on. Cost increase, considering mixing of pooled gas and current Brent level, other gas prices have gone up.

triggers.label: FY26 volume growth 8.25%
triggers.quote: Average gas sales for the current year ending 31st March 2026 is 4.585 mmscmd, whereas it was 4.235 mmscmd in the last financial year, which is an increase of 8.25%.

triggers.label: HH supply cut to ~50% in March
triggers.quote: HH was curtailed to a slightly lower level, maybe to 50% of our 1.5 contracted quantity.

triggers.label: FY27 volume >10% possible, unquantified margin
triggers.quote: we can definitely -- if number of customers get added faster, we can achieve 10% volume. Okay . Not necessarily, I'm saying 26-27.

guidance.quote: we can definitely -- if number of customers get added faster, we can achieve 10% volume.

guidance.value: endeavour to maintain more than INR8
guidance.quote: we will maintain more than INR8 EBITDA per SCM, but we'll have to consider multiple factors
it will be whatever we have been giving, INR1,200 crores range.

red_flags.label: Margin visibility lost; CNG pass-through incomplete
red_flags.quote: Coming to margins, I think it's a very difficult call as of today because nobody knows how long this kind of a situation and supply of RLNG will improve.

red_flags.label: Q4 PAT down QoQ; FY26 PAT 847 vs 1,041 crore
red_flags.quote: Net profit after tax for FY 2025 -'26 is INR847 crores compared to net profit after tax for the previous financial year of INR1,041 crores.

evasions.quote: We are not privy to that. So, we don't know.
giving a number is really difficult as of now.
all depends on how fast and when West Asia crisis is over, which nobody can tell today.
